content.text: The long email address overflows the card on desktop. On mobile it also pushes the page wider than the screen (424px against 375px). I'll fix it in the CSS.

I fixed the contact page layout. The long support email (`[EMAIL]`) was overflowing its card.

- **Desktop:** the email ran past the right edge of the "Other ways to reach us" card.
- **Mobile:** the same line made the whole page about 50px wider than the screen. That meant sideways scrolling and a header and footer that stopped short of the edge.

The change is in `site/css/pages.css`. The email now wraps inside the card. I also set the grid columns to `min-width: 0` so one long line can't stretch the page.

After the change, the page width matches the screen at 1280px, 375px and 320px. The 16 functional tests still pass.

On desktop the email now breaks mid-word (`…acmestoref` / `ront.example`). It is readable, but not pretty. Shortening the address or widening the card would look cleaner.

I couldn't tell what changed "yesterday", because the repo has only one commit. I found this by rendering the page. If the customer saw something else, such as a different browser or device, send me the details and I'll check again.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
